problem_context.problem_statement: Reverify CircularAreaDivideRdData using the unique shared CircularAreaLogicalState and mixed buffer ownership. The helper must be callable from every valid unified circular-area state, compute whether readidx + data_length crosses capacity, and preserve the entire state. The null branch must match real C ERROR=1.
problem_context.expected_behavior: For a non-null valid unified state and 0 <= data_length <= area_length, return 0 iff readidx + data_length <= area_length, otherwise 1. Preserve descriptor identity and all fields, logical FIFO, physical option-byte list, GlobalStrings and UCharArray::mixed_full. For null return ERROR=1.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Use CircularAreaLogicalState/CircularAreaBackingResource from the common QCIPLib as the only non-null representation before and after. Return the identical existential state values. Do not read or convert backing cells.
spec_hint: Keep CircularAreaDivideRdDataResult as the local pure result relation. Remove descriptor-only state and UCharArray::full from the callable contract. Retain parameter/pre-state and non-null bridges needed to refold CircularAreaBackingResource.
preferred_hidden_properties: direct composability inside CircularAreaRead and after Init/Write/Read/Reset under the same unified state

hidden_properties: the identical descriptor and every existential state value are returned
the logical FIFO and physical option-byte list are preserved
UCharArray::mixed_full is opened only as an internal spatial bridge and is not read
GlobalStrings remains caller-owned frame state and is therefore preserved by calls
the public arithmetic domain is exactly 0 <= data_length <= area_length; the uint32 overflow fact is derived internally from CircularAreaLogicalState
known_risks: Canonical fresh-manual generation remains controller-owned; direct preview symexec reported that the pre-existing manual file was not overwritten.
The expected downstream target set is three manual obligations: one backing-resource unfolding entailment and two return/refolding obligations.
